rationale:
The production fix is a single-token correction in lib/src/codepage.dart's _createDecoder: `result[i] = char;` becomes `result[i++] = char;`. Without the increment, the loop writes every decoded character into slot 0 and leaves i at 0, so any custom CodePage decoder table is never populated and the subsequent `if (i < 256)` guard misfires. The commit subject ('Add missing increment to custom code-page decoder.') and traceability (verified_fix_issue_numbers=[47], path fix_commit_to_issue) tie this to dart-archive/convert#47, which is the sole allowed root-cause key and is not present in active_same_project_root_causes (empty). The minimized production patch equals production-fix.patch and touches only that one line: no formatting, refactor, doc, or config edits, and the test file is split out into trigger-tests.patch. The trigger is the unmodified upstream test 'Custom code page' from the same fixing commit; it exercises pre-existing public API only (CodePage constructor, encode with invalidCharacter, decode with allowInvalid), none of which the fix introduces or changes signatures for, and its decode expectations are exactly what the missing increment breaks. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs passes every gate: build on both revisions, isolated buggy differential failure on test/codepage_test.dart::Custom code page, deterministic fingerprints across 3 repetitions, fixed-revision isolated/suite/reversed runs green, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the declared trigger.
